title: NOBODY HOME
subtitle: Rooms after erasure — intact passage, person-removal intervention, and inspection triptych
lineage: Primary: SCION 085 (Jeanne Dielman) · Supporting: SCION 067 ((nostalgia)), SCION 097 (Welcome to Pine Point)
theorem: Show an intact room sequence where a person occupies and interacts with furniture; return to a version with the person computationally removed while room effects remain; hold the empty aftermath; end with an Original / Mask / Derived comparison.
boundary_note: Computational removal is an authored intervention; the person mask and inpainted background stay separate from recorded pixels and do not claim the historical room was empty.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #02 (t=03.50s-12.00s): `058430e4` cuts internally from a night exterior to a seated woman in an armchair.
Seg #04 (t=19.50s-28.00s) & Seg #07 (t=42.50s-51.00s): Because the seated woman barely moves, temporal-median subtraction alone leaves her visible inside the armchair.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: The core person-removal intervention in Seg #04 and Seg #07 failed to erase the person because temporal-median subtraction alone cannot remove a nearly stationary seated figure.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: Applying pure temporal-median subtraction to a stationary figure (`058430e4`, plus crossing the cut at 3.0s) baked the person into the median background.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Clamp `058430e4` strictly to its continuous interior living-room shot (`3.6s-11.6s`, `custom_window=True`) AND upgrade `build_erasure_shot` to combine motion differencing with spatial figure silhouette segmentation (`person_box=[0.30, 0.16, 0.72, 0.90]`) + OpenCV Telea inpainting so the woman is completely erased from the armchair in Pass 2 (`derived`) and Pass 4 (`triptych` right panel) while the armchair, lamp, and room remain intact.
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: The 3-panel inspection triptych layout (`Original | Extracted Mask | Derived Empty Room`) and the held naturally empty modernist rooms (`27f75a9f` and `b2e97ba8`).
